description: Lists the OS, browser and device combinations LambdaTest supports, to find valid os, browser and version values for a test configuration. With no filters it returns a compact summary: each desktop OS with its browsers (version count, newest and oldest) and resolutions, and each mobile platform with its device count and OS versions. Set os (and optionally browser) for the full version list, or os=ios / os=android for device names.

browser.description: Browser to expand on desktop, e.g. "chrome", "firefox", "edge", "safari"

os.description: OS name to expand, matched case-insensitively as a substring, e.g. "Windows 11", "Sonoma", "android"

type.description: Only desktop OSes or only mobile platforms

name: getSupportedPlatforms
title: Get Supported Platforms
